title.narrative: FOSTERING PEACEFUL, CREDIBLE AND INCLUSIVE ELECTIONS IN SIERRA LEONE 2022-2023

description.narrative: This project aims to enhance the capacity of key institutions such as the Electoral Commission of Sierra Leone (ECSL), the Political Party Registration Commission (PPRC), the Judiciary and the Security Sector. It also aims to enhance transparency of and inclusion in the electoral processes by promoting citizen engagement, information sharing and integrity working with a range of stakeholders, including the Independent Commissions and Civil Society Organizations (CSOs). The project has three outputs: (1) Institutional capacity of electoral stakeholders is enhanced, (2) Transparency in the electoral process is enhanced, and (3) Inclusion in electoral processes is promoted and citizen engagement is strengthened. The UN Peace Building Fund supports the fourth ‘Peace’ pillar through the Enabling Environment for Peaceful Elections and Strengthening Social Cohesion in Sierra Leone project.
